sections.heading: Provenance, Legislative Objective & Doctrinal Foundations
sections.body: This topic covers s. 222–225 under the Indian Contract Act, 1872. Read the statutory scheme as a coherent allocation of rights, duties, conditions, defences and consequences.

sections.heading: Textual Anatomy, Provisos & Statutory Deconstruction
sections.body: s. 222–225 must be broken into definitions, operative words, conditions, exceptions, savings and consequences. Map the agreement and commercial records to each statutory ingredient.

sections.heading: Mandatory Proving Ingredients & Essential Elements
sections.body:
1. Establish the transaction and parties.
2. Identify the statutory trigger in s. 222–225.
3. Prove each constituent fact.
4. Test exceptions and defences.
5. Identify the precise legal consequence.

sections.heading: Evidentiary Burdens under BSA 2023 (ss. 104–106 & s. 63)
sections.body: The asserting party ordinarily bears the initial burden on essential facts, subject to admissions and statutory presumptions. Electronic records should be authenticated and presented under the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023.

sections.heading: Procedural Roadmap, Competent Forum & Limitation Act Checkpoints
sections.body: Check jurisdiction, limitation, arbitration or jurisdiction clauses, court fees and the exact relief. Verify the applicable Limitation Act Article and accrual date.
